## Specification

### Component: Kbd

A key cap for shortcuts. Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
- `<kbd class="ui-kbd [ui-kbd-sm|ui-kbd-lg]">` is one key. `<span class="ui-kbd-group [ui-kbd-group-plus]">` groups keys (`role="group"` when it has an `aria-label`).

#### Props
- `Kbd`: `size` `sm` 20px · `md` 24px (default) · `lg` 28px. `KbdGroup`: `plus` draws "+" between keys.

#### Visual rules
- Mono face, 12px/500 (lg 13px), min-width = height, padding-inline 6px, radius `--radius-sm`.
- Fill `--ui-surface`, text `--ui-muted-foreground`, 1px `--ui-border`, lip `box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--ui-border-strong)`.
- Group gap 4px; with `plus` gap 14px and a "+" (`content: "+" / ""`, muted) centred in the gap.

#### Accessibility
- Semantic `<kbd>`; the "+" is generated content with empty alt text. Add `aria-label` to a symbol-only group.

#### Acceptance checks
- Heights 20/24/28; text meets 4.5:1 in light and dark.

## Files

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged.

### `ui/components/kbd/index.ts`

```ts
export * from './kbd';
```

### `ui/components/kbd/kbd.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type KbdSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export interface KbdProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  /** 20 / 24 / 28px tall. Default `md`. */
  size?: KbdSize;
}

/** Kbd — one key cap. Server Component–safe. Symbols (⌘ ⇧ ⌥) or short words (Esc, Enter). */
export const Kbd = forwardRef<HTMLElement, KbdProps>(function Kbd({ size, className, ...props }, ref) {
  return <kbd ref={ref} className={cn('ui-kbd', size && size !== 'md' && `ui-kbd-${size}`, className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface KbdGroupProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {
  /** Draw a "+" between the keys. Default: keys sit side by side. */
  plus?: boolean;
}

/** KbdGroup — a combination such as ⌘ K or Ctrl + Shift + P. */
export const KbdGroup = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, KbdGroupProps>(function KbdGroup(
  { plus = false, className, role, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  // A labelled group is announced as a group (a bare aria-label on a span is not valid)
  return <span ref={ref} role={role ?? (props['aria-label'] ? 'group' : undefined)} className={cn('ui-kbd-group', plus && 'ui-kbd-group-plus', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/kbd.css`

```css
/* Kbd ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   <kbd class="ui-kbd">⌘</kbd>   + size: -sm -lg (md default)
   Combo: <span class="ui-kbd-group [ui-kbd-group-plus]"> <kbd/> <kbd/> </span>
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-kbd {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 1.5rem;
    height: 1.5rem;
    padding-inline: 0.375rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    /* the key's lip */
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 var(--ui-border-strong);
    font-family: var(--ui-font-mono);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .ui-kbd > svg { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-kbd-sm { min-width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; padding-inline: 0.25rem; }
  .ui-kbd-lg { min-width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; padding-inline: 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-size: var(--text-sm); }

  .ui-kbd-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; vertical-align: middle; }
  .ui-kbd-group-plus > .ui-kbd + .ui-kbd::before {
    content: "+" / "";
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-start: -0.5625rem;
    top: 50%;
    translate: 0 -50%;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .ui-kbd-group-plus > .ui-kbd { position: relative; }
  .ui-kbd-group-plus { gap: 0.875rem; }
}
```

## Usage

**Keys and combinations** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/kbd/shortcuts.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from '@/ui/components/kbd';

export default function KbdShortcuts() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-6">
        <Kbd>Esc</Kbd>
        <Kbd>Enter</Kbd>
        <Kbd>Tab</Kbd>
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd>⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd>K</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
        <KbdGroup plus>
          <Kbd>Ctrl</Kbd>
          <Kbd>Shift</Kbd>
          <Kbd>P</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-6">
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd size="sm">⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd size="sm">S</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd>⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd>S</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd size="lg">⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd size="lg">S</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
